system.name: FastLongSpeech
system.one_liner: A framework that lets a speech-language model process long speech efficiently by iteratively fusing similar adjacent speech frames, trained without long-speech data.

content.variant_note: a bottom-up model stack with a dotted wedge into the extractor, plus a right panel that redraws one frame row after each fusion iteration
content.argues: Merging runs of similar adjacent frames, weighted by content density, shrinks a long speech sequence to the LLM's speech window before the language model sees it.
content.subject: The FastLongSpeech model stack and, beside it, iterative fusion followed on toy speech frames with similarity scores and content densities.

lessons.what_to_learn: Explain a compression step by redrawing the same row of frames after each iteration, with grouped frames in dotted span boxes and the deciding numbers written between and under the frames; tie that detail panel to the architecture with a dotted wedge from the module.

an advanced extractor module, which features a CTC decoder and employs our proposed iterative fusion strategy

summary: FastLongSpeech extends a speech-language model built on Qwen2-Audio to long speech without long-speech training data, by compressing the speech representations with an iterative fusion strategy. Figure 1 has two panels on one grey canvas. The left panel is a bottom-up stack: a speech waveform goes through an Audio Encoder, an Extractor and a Projector into the FastLongSpeech box (flame icon, headphone mascot), with text-token boxes for the instruction and the response; a dotted wedge opens the Extractor into Iterative Fusion and a CTC Decoder. The right panel follows iterative fusion on toy frames: similarity scores between neighbours and content densities underneath pick spans that are merged, shrinking six frames to three and then two.
summary_zh: FastLongSpeech 用迭代融合压缩长语音帧，使语音语言模型无需长语音训练数据即可处理长语音。图左自下而上画出音频编码器、提取器、投影器到 LLM，并用虚线放大提取器；图右用带相似度和内容密度数字的玩具帧演示逐轮合并。
notes: Two panels kept (the paper itself speaks of a left and a right panel). Flame and snowflake are not defined in the legend; reading them as trainable and frozen is the usual convention, not stated in the text given. What the dashed arrow from the CTC Decoder carries is not stated in the text given. The mascot's origin is judged from its style.
